question: the D-pad is wired one position out (D-731).  What is the cheapest correct repair?
verdict: EXPANDER PIN REASSIGNMENT, NOT A PART MOVE.  Zero copper changed.
why: D-731 proposed a 5-cycle of SWITCH POSITIONS.  That is geometrically free but it
does NOT route: it puts a fourth ~40 mm haul into the west-to-U2 corridor and
BTN_UP_N was left open at every request order.
The copper as built is CORRECT: every switch reaches a distinct PCAL9535A port-1
input with an identical 10k pull-up.  What was wrong was only WHICH FUNCTION each
expander bit was declared to carry.  All eight port-1 pins are inputs, all are
interrupt-capable and all power up masked, so the function-to-pin assignment is a
free variable -- an implementation detail, not a product decision.
Renaming the five nets therefore corrects the defect with ZERO copper, ZERO part
moves, ZERO BOM lines and no enclosure/industrial-design decision.
front_face_frame: doc coords: x_doc = x_pcb, y_doc = 148 - y_pcb (FBV2_PCB_DATUM lower-left, X right, Y up; F.Cu = FRONT)

second_defect_found_and_fixed.what: the U2 sheet-08 note named P05/P06/P16/P17 WRONG
second_defect_found_and_fixed.consequence_if_shipped: the note tells firmware to leave 4Ah bit 6 masked.  4Ah bit 6 is P06 = TOUCH_INT_N, so the TOUCH INTERRUPT would have been masked and BQ25185_STAT2 -- which toggles continuously with no battery fitted -- would have been left UNMASKED and would have woken the MCU forever.  Exactly inverted.
second_defect_found_and_fixed.fixed_in: 08_buttons_expanders.kicad_sch U2 note, rewritten pin by pin from the board

firmware_impact: NONE BROKEN.  Firmware/src/config.h carries only the Wokwi simulation buttons and a stale TCA9535 comment; no physical D-pad bit map exists in the repository yet.  The corrected table in the schematic is now the only one.
